en:
## New Features

- Add gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna to the built-in Codex provider
- Redesign the notification center with Pending/Activity views and a unified attention entry; permission and DM items deep-link into the right session
- Ship Model Cards v2 (full metadata plus local overrides) and let subagents follow the parent model in real time
- Track AI usage per user with lifetime rollups, charts, CSV export, and request attribution through subagents
- Add a collapsible Git commit graph panel with swimlane layout and safe degradation when parent topology is unknown
- Show a queued phase on tool cards when earlier calls still occupy the execution slot; stop tool status from lagging one call behind
- Set a model as default/summary directly from the model menu; keep dock split ratios when swapping panels

## Bug Fixes

- Make interrupted message admission and tool status transitions reliable across handoffs and retries
- Block structural edits from running on a truncated outline; reject zero-width match spam and unreachable capture-group templates before writing
- Bound outline traversal by visited nodes and frame depth so deep synthetic files cannot stack-overflow or stall the main thread
- Interrupted merges now clear only metadata and keep conflict coordinates; header measurement waits for a real ready gate
- Uniquify AskUserQuestion answer keys by header so colliding titles no longer silently overwrite answers
- Repair seq floor lazily without full-table scans; fix subagent archive lifecycle and extract-primary as a standalone narrator
- Detect Windows process termination across restarts and fall back cleanly when SSE parameters are rejected
- Fix workspace reconnect, Markdown streaming render regressions, and parcel watcher command delivery/ACK leaks
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 内置 Codex 供应商补齐 gpt-6-sol 与 gpt-6-luna
- 通知中心改为待处理/动态双视图，统一注意力入口；权限与 DM 条目可深链到对应会话
- 模型卡 v2：完整元数据 + 本地覆盖层；子代理默认跟随父模型实时解析
- 按用户统计 AI 用量：累计账本、图表、CSV 导出，请求归属贯通子代理链路
- Git 面板新增可折叠提交图（swimlane 布局），拓扑未知时安全退化为单列
- 工具卡新增排队相位，修复状态滞后一个工具调用的问题
- 模型菜单可就地设为默认/摘要模型；dock 交换面板保持分栏比例

## 修复

- 中断场景下消息准入与工具状态切换更可靠，避免交接丢消息或旧状态覆盖新状态
- 结构化编辑禁止在截断大纲上执行；写入前拦掉零宽匹配刷屏与引用不到的捕获组模板
- 大纲走查补上访问节点与遍历深度上限，深嵌套文件不再栈溢出或拖死主线程
- 中断合并只清元数据并保留冲突坐标；Header 测量增加就绪门
- AskUserQuestion 按 header 唯一化答案键，撞名标题不再静默覆盖
- seq floor 改为惰性修复，不再启动全表扫描；修复子代理归档生命周期与另存为独立主叙述者
- Windows 跨启动进程终止判定更准确，SSE 参数被拒时干净回退
- 修复工作区重连、Markdown 流式渲染回归，以及 parcel watcher 命令送达与 ACK 泄漏
